# Bothell Power Washing

> Professional pressure washing in Bothell, WA and the greater Eastside.

Bothell Power Washing provides residential and commercial exterior cleaning services in Bothell, WA and surrounding communities including Kenmore, Woodinville, Kirkland, Sammamish, Redmond, and Mill Creek.

## Services
- [Pressure Washing](https://www.bothellpowerwashing.com/pressure-washing.html)
- [Driveway Cleaning](https://www.bothellpowerwashing.com/driveway-cleaning.html)
- [Deck & Patio Washing](https://www.bothellpowerwashing.com/deck-washing.html)
- Roof Cleaning & Moss Treatment
- Gutter Cleaning
- Commercial Power Washing
